title: In the Shadow of Zekrom!
overview: Arriving in the Unova region, Ash must suddenly deal with the loss of Pikachu's Electric-type powers!

title: Enter Iris and Axew!
overview: Continuing their journey in the Unova region, Ash and Pikachu come across some new friends, as well as some old rivals!

title: A Sandile Gusher of Change!
overview: On their way to Striaton City and Ash's first Unova Gym Battle challenge, our Heroes come across a family whose hotel is in dire need of help!

title: The Battle Club and Tepig's Choice!
overview: On his way to Striaton City and Ash's first Gym Battle challenge in the Unova Region, our Hero discovers the Pokémon Battle Club, and a new friend as well!

title: Triple Leaders, Team Threats!
overview: As Ash faces off against a most unusual Gym Leader challenge at the Striaton Gym, Team Rocket prepares to embark on the mission of a lifetime!

title: Dreams by the Yard Full!
overview: As Ash's first Unova region Gym Battle challenge continues, Ash discovers a kindred spirit in Cilan - one of the three Striaton City Gym Leaders!

title: Snivy Plays Hard to Catch!
overview: Continuing onto Nacrene City and his second Gym Battle challenge, Ash comes across an amazing Snivy that proves difficult to catch indeed!

title: Saving Darmanitan from the Bell!
overview: As our Heroes head toward Nacrene City and Ash's next Gym Battle, they come across a pair of Darumaka behaving in a most peculiar manner!

title: The Bloom Is on Axew!
overview: A surprise Battle between Iris, Axew, Cilan and Pansage reveals the story of a promise made not so long ago...

title: A Rival Battle for Club Champ!
overview: Stopping at a Battle Club on his way to the Nacrene City Gym, Ash is surprised to find that his Unova region rival, Trip, is there as well!

title: A Home for Dwebble!
overview: On their way to the Nacrene City Gym, our Heroes come across a Dwebble with an unusual housing problem!

title: Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!
overview: Continuing to Nacrene City and Ash's next Gym Battle, our Heroes meet a boisterous Kindergarten class and its beloved Trubbish, as well as the Kindergarten teacher who does not share the same opinion!

title: Minccino-Neat and Tidy!
overview: On their way to Nacrene City, our Heroes run into Professor Juniper's helper, Bianca, offering up one surprise after another!

title: A Night in the Nacrene City Museum!
overview: Arriving in Nacrene City, our Heroes discover the Gym has a most unusual location and situation!

title: The Battle According to Lenora!
overview: The day for Ash's Nacrene City Gym Battle challenge is here, and Lenora isn't about to go easy on our Hero!

title: Rematch at the Nacrene Gym!
overview: With Ash's rematch challenge at the Nacrene City Gym coming soon, the first order of business is some serious special training!

title: Scraggy-Hatched to Be Wild!
overview: Ash's Pokémon Egg is ready to hatch, and our Heroes are in for some surprising adventures as a result!

title: Sewaddle and Burgh in Pinwheel Forest!
overview: After our Heroes get lost in a large forest on their way to Castelia City, what they find more than makes up for being lost!

title: A Connoisseur's Revenge!
overview: Discovering a brand new Poké Mart on their way to Castelia City, our Heroes come across a most unusual Pokémon Connoisseur!

title: Dancing with the Ducklett Trio!
overview: On their way to Castelia City, our heroes come across their old Pokémon friend Sandile, and three mischievous Pokémon who are anything but friendly!

title: The Lost World of Gothitelle!
overview: City, crossing the Skyarrow Bridge proves more complicated then they thought it would be!

title: A Venipede Stampede!
overview: After arriving in Castelia City, our heroes discover an enormous colony of Venipede swarming the city and threatening its citizens!

title: Battling for the Love of Bug-Types!
overview: The exciting moment for Ash's Gym Battle with Burgh, the Castelia Gym Leader, has finally arrived!

title: Emolga the Irresistible!
overview: As our heroes, along with their old friend Bianca, continue toward the Nimbasa Gym, they come across a Pokémon that Bianca just has to catch!

title: Emolga and the New Volt Switch!
overview: As our heroes continue toward Nimbasa City, Iris's new friend Emolga proves just how amazing and unpredictable a Pokémon can be!

title: Scare at the Litwick Mansion!
overview: Seeking shelter from a raging rain storm, our heroes enter what appears to be an empty mansion, but what turns out to be anything BUT empty!

title: The Dragon Master's Path!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City and Ash's fourth Gym Battle challenge, our heroes meet a fledgling Trainer with an important decision to make!

title: Oshawott's Lost Scalchop!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes come across a Trainer and his Blitzle who put Oshawott to the battle test!

title: Cottonee in Love!
overview: As our heroes continue their journey to Nimbasa City, they encounter a lovesick Cottonee with confidence issues!

title: A UFO for Elgyem!
overview: Continuing to Nimbasa City, our heroes witness a mysterious UFO and Pokémon, with even more mysterious origins!

title: Ash and Trip's Third Battle!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes run into Ash's rival Trip, leading to a third battle between two very determined Trainers!

title: Facing Fear with Eyes Wide Open!
overview: Many of our heroes' Pokémon have fallen ill from the poison spores of a group of Foongus, and Oshawott must face its fear in order to help provide the cure!

title: Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes meet a Dragon Buster named Georgia, who unexpectedly changes the relationship between Iris and Excadrill forever!

title: Gotta Catch a Roggenrola!
overview: While on their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes' lunch is interrupted by a feisty Roggenrola, which leads them to thwart another sinister Team Rocket plan!

title: Where Did You Go, Audino?
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes get involved in an investigation of disappearing Audino and meet a couple of budding young sleuths in the process!

title: Archeops in the Modern World!
overview: Reuniting with their old friends, Professor Juniper and Dr. Fennel, our heroes witness the restoration of the ancient Pokémon Archen!

title: A Fishing Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City and Ash's next Gym Battle, a fishing competition "lures" our heroes into a sinister Team Rocket plot!

title: Movie Time! Zorua in 'The Legend of the Pokémon Knight'!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, a discussion about favorite movies and movie actors leads our heroes to a memorable encounter with a budding filmmaker and his amazing partner, Zorua!

title: Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!
overview: The day of the Nimbasa Town Pokémon Battle Tournament is here for our heroes, and it's a happy meeting of lots of old friends as well!

title: Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia! (1)
overview: It's Cilan versus Trip during round one of the Nimbasa Town Club Battle! Then, for round two, it's Ash versus Georgia!!

title: The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk! (2)
overview: The second round bouts of the Club Battle rage on, culminating in a roaring battle between Iris's agile Emolga and Stephan's powerful Sawk!

title: The Club Battle Finale: A Heroes Outcome! (3)
overview: The moment for the final round of the Nimbasa Pokémon Club Battle has arrived, with two good friends battling head-to-head!

title: Meowth's Scrafty Tactics!
overview: A surprise appearance by none other than Meowth has helped our heroes to solve one problem after another!

title: Purrloin, Sweet or Sneaky?
overview: Continuing their journey and still accompanied by Meowth, our heroes come across a Purrloin in distress, though not everyone is buying its pleas for help!

title: Beheeyem, Duosion, and the Dream Thief!
overview: On their way to Nimbasa City, our heroes, along with Meowth, have found themselves in a dream they can't seem to awaken from!

title: The Beartic Mountain Feud!
overview: As our heroes, traveling with Meowth, approach Nimbasa City, they discover a lost Cubchoo, which leads them into a dangerous confrontation!

title: Crisis from the Underground Up! (1)
overview: Our heroes have arrived in Nimbasa City, unaware that a crisis of major proportions is about to be unleashed!

title: Battle for the Underground! (2)
overview: As Team Rocket continues their attempt to steal the Pokémon from the Nimbasa City Pokémon Center, our heroes must successfully stop Team Rocket's escaping Ghost Train - at all costs!

title: Enter Elesa, Electrifying Gym Leader!
overview: After meeting the Nimbasa City Gym Leader, Elesa, our heroes encounter an old friend with a surprise guest!

title: Dazzling the Nimbasa Gym!
overview: The stakes are high for Ash winning his fourth Unova Gym Badge at the Nimbasa Gym, and our hero's taking no chances!

title: Lost at the Stamp Rally!
overview: Spending the day in Nimbasa City after Ash's fourth Unova Gym Badge win, Cilan has a special challenge in mind, while our heroes discover a fellow Trainer in need!

title: Ash Versus the Champion!
overview: As our heroes prepare to leave Nimbasa City, they bump into Ash's rival Trip, who introduces them to someone they had only dreamed of meeting!

title: A Maractus Musical!
overview: On their way to Driftveil City, our heroes meet an enterprising young man with three dedicated friends and a dream!

title: The Four Seasons of Sawsbuck!
overview: Stopping at a Pokémon Center on their way to Driftveil City, out heroes meet a young Pokémon photographer on the mission of a lifetime!

title: Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!
overview: On their way to Driftveil City and Ash's next Gym Battle, our heroes meet a demanding Gothita with a crush on Scraggy!

title: The Lonely Deino!
overview: On their way to Driftveil City and Ash's next Gym Battle, our heroes come across some very special Pokémon in a very special place!

title: The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!
overview: Arriving in Driftveil City, our heroes meet a fascinating hometown resident with a secret!

title: A Call for Brotherly Love!
overview: While Ash prepares for his upcoming Gym Battle with Clay, a surprise visitor with a dilemma offers both Ash and Cilan the opportunity to help!

title: Stopping the Rage of Legends! (1)
overview: What started as a trip to Milos Island to find Revival Herbs has turned into a cataclysmic battle of legendary proportions!

title: Stopping the Rage of Legends! (2)
overview: In search of scarce Revival Herbs, our heroes are now faced with the potential destruction of Milos Island!

title: Battling the King of the Mines!
overview: With a bag full of revival herbs, our heroes have returned to Driftveil City and Ash is raring to battle Gym Leader Clay!

title: Crisis at Chargestone Cave!
overview: Continuing their journey to Mistralton City, our heroes encounter Chargestone Cave and a dilemma for its occupants!

title: Evolution Exchange Excitement!
overview: After witnessing a dramatic Pokémon trade and evolution, Ash and his friends' excitement has just begun!

title: Explorers of the Hero's Ruin!
overview: The elder Professor Juniper has invited our heroes to join him in what he promises will be an exciting adventure...and he keeps his promise!

title: Battling the Bully!
overview: An encounter with Pikachu's rival from the past puts our heroes in the middle of a bullying confrontation!

title: Baffling the Bouffalant!
overview: An encounter with some very angry Bouffalant forces our heroes to take some unexpected precautions!

title: Cilan Takes Flight!
overview: Arriving at the Mistralton City Gym, our heroes are shocked to discover a Gym Leader with a battle style they never would have imagined!

title: An Amazing Aerial Battle!
overview: Not only is the Mistralton City Gym Jet Badge on the line, but the Gym Leader's method of battling as well!

title: Climbing the Tower of Success!
overview: After reuniting with two old friends, our heroes prepare to participate in a competition that takes making a wish to a higher level!

title: The Clubsplosion Begins! (1)
overview: Don George's Clubsplosion Tournament is getting underway, and our heroes obviously have several rivals with scores to settle!

title: Search for the Clubultimate! (2)
overview: Round one of the Clubsplosion Tournament rages on, and the explosive action more than lives up to its name!

title: A Clubsplosion of Excitement! (3)
overview: As round one of the Clubsplosion nears completion, round two promises even more excitement with every match!

title: Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown! (4)
overview: The Clubsplosion Tournament is all about intense head-to-head battling, but the final round is about to raise the battle bar high!

title: Battling the Leaf Thieves!
overview: As our heroes continue toward Icirrus City, a joyous event precedes a kidnapping crisis!

title: A Restoration Confrontation! (1)
overview: Ash, Cilan, and Iris make their way to Twist Mountain where they come across a fossil dig that has discovered a fossil Tirtouga. However, Team Rocket arrives and steals the fossil.

title: A Restoration Confrontation! (2)
overview: As our heroes battle to save their new Pokémon friends, the survival of an entire world is at stake!

title: Evolution by Fire!
overview: Stopping for the night at Don George's Pokémon Battle Club on their way to Icirrus City, our heroes come across a Trainer with a surprising connection to their past!

title: Guarding the Guardian of the Mountain!
overview: As our heroes near Icirrus City and Ash's next Gym Battle, they find themselves face to face with the star-studded stuff of legends!

title: Caution: Icy Battle Conditions!
overview: The chance for Ash to earn his seventh Unova Gym badge is here, and it's a slippery slope indeed!

title: Clash of the Connoisseurs!
overview: While pursuing Ash's eighth Unova Gym badge and subsequent entry into the Unova League, our heroes are summoned to a place where Cilan's Connoisseur skills are in high demand!

title: Crisis at Ferroseed Research!
overview: On their way to Virbank City, our heroes run into a familiar face and an icy emergency!

title: An Epic Defense Force!
overview: Arriving in Virbank City, an old friend gives our heroes a taste of movie making they will never forget!

title: Rocking the Virbank Gym! (1)
overview: Ash's quest for his eighth Gym badge gets underway-and the battle turns out to be a multimedia event indeed!

title: Rocking the Virbank Gym! (2)
overview: The Gym is jumping, the fans are cheering, and the quest for Ash's eighth Unova Gym badge is red-hot and rocking!
